lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard the early bird,
Gets the worm? that's so absurd!
He frowned, I will not eat a worm!
Kiki laughed to see him squirm!
[chorus]
The early bird, the early bird,
Catches the worm, haven't you heard?
The early bird, the early bird,
Rise and shine, be first, not third!
[verse]
It means the one who starts the day,
Gets the best before the fray,
Act early and you'll win the prize,
So open up those sleepy eyes!
[chorus]
The early bird, the early bird,
Catches the worm, haven't you heard?
The early bird, the early bird,
Be the first, spread the word!
[outro]
So when the sunrise paints the sky,
Rise and shine and give it a try!
